# Code of conduct — 1.0.0

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.vi.md)
We expect respectful, technically grounded discussion. Welcoming behavior includes constructive review, sharing reproducible evidence, respecting different levels of experience and acknowledging mistakes.

Harassment, personal attacks, unauthorized disclosure of private credentials or security material, and deliberate disruption are unacceptable.

Maintainers may edit, hide or remove abusive contributions and restrict participation when necessary. Report sensitive incidents privately to Đăng Khoa at i.am@dangkhoa.dev rather than posting identifying information publicly.

This policy applies to issues, pull requests, discussions and other project collaboration spaces.
